text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"A meta-analysis of 82 studies with 3,574 estimates found a small but positive average effect of working from home on employee productivity.","cited_pids":["0a130e4f39dc#0"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"The positive meta-analytic effect of working from home was driven by gains in hourly productivity and increased hours worked.","cited_pids":["0a130e4f39dc#0"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"A synthesis of 50+ studies reports a median productivity impact of +10% for individual focused tasks and -4% for collaborative tasks.","cited_pids":["d658dc380b73#5"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"A randomized trial at Trip.com found hybrid schedules showed no measurable productivity difference from in-office peers.","cited_pids":["d658dc380b73#5"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"A 2023 working paper reported output falls of 10-20% for some roles, particularly collaborative ones, under fully remote work.","cited_pids":["d658dc380b73#6"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"A study linked full-remote work of five days a week to reduced work productivity.","cited_pids":["abefd158b9c2#2"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"A field experiment found discretionary remote days helped mothers without harming non-mothers.","cited_pids":["ef88116f982d#0"]}]}
